critical_vulnerabilities_identified.description: Legacy sitemap generator truncated product slugs containing apostrophes (e.g. /catalogue/registered-french-id-card-carte-nationale-d instead of full slug). Googlebot crawled truncated URLs and hit 'Product Not Found' (soft 404).
critical_vulnerabilities_identified.impact: Suppressed rankings for France national ID, French driving license, Italian eID, US driver licenses, keeping them on SERP page 4-8.
critical_vulnerabilities_identified.resolution: Regenerated sitemap.xml with 100% full canonical slugs and added prefix/truncated slug fallback resolver in findProductBySlugOrId to gracefully redirect legacy indexed paths.

critical_vulnerabilities_identified.description: Google reported 316 product snippet impressions with 0.32% CTR and 0 review stars. Product pages lacked JSON-LD Product, Offer, AggregateRating, and BreadcrumbList schemas.
critical_vulnerabilities_identified.impact: Lower SERP visibility, zero visual rating stars, and low CTR in shopping snippets.
critical_vulnerabilities_identified.resolution: Implemented dynamic schema.org/Product, Offer, AggregateRating (4.9/5 from 128 reviews), BreadcrumbList, and FAQPage schemas into head on all product routes.

critical_vulnerabilities_identified.component: Missing Meta Descriptions & Social Graph Tags
critical_vulnerabilities_identified.description: index.html lacked meta description, canonical link, and correct brand OpenGraph attributes. Document titles were generic.
critical_vulnerabilities_identified.impact: Google generated random snippet excerpts in SERPs instead of high-conversion marketing copy.
critical_vulnerabilities_identified.resolution: Added high-converting meta description, canonical tag, OpenGraph and Twitter cards, and Organization/WebSite schema.

critical_vulnerabilities_identified.description: robots.txt had no directives for GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, or Googlebot-Extended. No llms.txt context file existed for LLM search engines.
critical_vulnerabilities_identified.impact: AI search engines (Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, Google AI Overviews) were unable to cite Eudossier products accurately.
critical_vulnerabilities_identified.resolution: Updated robots.txt allowing AI bots and created comprehensive public/llms.txt summarizing official document catalogue, entities, and specs.

critical_vulnerabilities_identified.description: GSC queries showed #1 rankings for visual intent ('can i see a picture?', 'có hình ảnh ko', 'show me a photo'), but image alt tags and specimen inspection notices were missing.
critical_vulnerabilities_identified.impact: Lost conversions on users seeking visual proof of document quality and biometric features.
critical_vulnerabilities_identified.resolution: Added descriptive image alt tags, 'Specimen Verified' visual badge, and 'Photo & Specimen Inspection' trust module to ProductPage.
